title: Consolidate complaint-generator sprawl into versioned module interfaces

execution_policy.native_task_source_profile: explicit legacy-markdown projection of the Native FormalWorkPlan
execution_policy.parallelism: Tasks with satisfied dependencies and disjoint targets may run together. CIMP-CON-01 through CIMP-CON-04, CIMP-CON-06 through CIMP-CON-13, CIMP-CON-15, and CIMP-CON-21 through CIMP-CON-24 have no dependencies. Later tasks wait only on the files they edit.
execution_policy.development_inputs: Published origin/main at 0dc792d12. The earlier repository-reorganization board is historical and is not restarted.
execution_policy.implementation_provider_scope: Authorized Grok 4.7 development implementation via llm_router. Offline tests do not disable that provider process. Development permission is not consent to case-data egress.
execution_policy.product_inference: This plan does not change case inference, consent, or legal conclusions.
execution_policy.protected_state: The completed intake, mediator-grounding, GUI collaboration, GUI UX, and repository-reorganization campaigns, both retained quarantines, submodule pins, and unrelated campaign processes stay untouched. completion_authority stays false.
execution_policy.upstream_checkout_policy: Use the pinned external checkouts. Do not float pins, recursively initialize submodules, or clone CommonCrawl.
required_evidence: A focused pytest module with positive and negative cases and zero skips
Moved files absent at the old path and present at the new path
Extracted symbols defined in the sibling module and delegated from the owner
execution_policy.qualification_scope: One focused pytest command per task. Do not run the full historical suite inside the 900-second task budget. tests/test_cimp_mod_19.py is expected to fail until CIMP-CON-05 rewrites it, and earlier tasks must not use it as their validation command.
execution_policy.stop_semantics: A test that passes while a required file remains at the repository root is a failed task. Do not mark a task complete by hand.

findings.observation: The previous reorganization board marked 26 tasks complete, but the 27 session names linked from docs/archive/sessions/INDEX.md are still files at the repository root. The archive directory contains the index and not those files. tests/test_cimp_mod_19.py asserts the root files exist and accepts unresolved archive links.

The repository root has 38 markdown files. Only README.md, DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, TESTING.md, and TODO.md are current entry docs. The other 33 are session reports, old READMEs, plans, and profiles.

The root contains maintenance scripts, collected-looking tests, and product bodies: document_pipeline.py is 12006 lines, document_optimization.py is 4860, claim_support_review.py is 6233, intake_status.py is 1681, and workflow_phase_guidance.py is 534. Tracked debug snapshots remain under tmp_validation_llm_draft, tmp_validation_llm_enabled, tmp_workspace_debug, and workspace.

Package interface modules record INTERFACE_VERSION 1.0.0 and parse owner files. Importing them does not export the symbols. main.py, mediator/workflow_service.py, and mediator/hook_runtime.py still import mediator.mediator.

ComplaintWorkspaceService, Mediator, FormalComplaintDocumentBuilder, ClaimSupportHook, ComplaintDenoiser, and AgenticDocumentOptimizer are single classes of thousands of lines. Named methods can move to sibling modules behind one-line delegations without changing their call signatures.
